import torch
from torch import nn
from torch.utils.data import TensorDataset, DataLoader

torch.manual_seed(0)
x = torch.linspace(-3.14, 3.14, 800).unsqueeze(1)
y = torch.sin(x) + 0.3 * torch.randn_like(x)
perm = torch.randperm(800)
X_train, y_train = x[perm[:800]], y[perm[:800]]
X_val, y_val = x[perm[800:]], y[perm[800:]]
train_loader = DataLoader(TensorDataset(X_train, y_train), batch_size=32, shuffle=True)

model = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(1, 64), nn.Tanh(), nn.Linear(64, 64), nn.Tanh(), nn.Linear(64, 1))
loss_fn = nn.MSELoss()
optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=0.003, weight_decay=1e-4)

for epoch in range(300):
    model.train()
    for xb, yb in train_loader:
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        loss = loss_fn(model(xb), yb)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
    model.eval()
    with torch.no_grad():
        val = loss_fn(model(X_val), y_val).item()
    if epoch % 10 == 0:
        print(f'epoch {epoch} train {loss.item():.4f} val {val:.4f}')
